name: onenine-native-replay-configured-agent
description: Pinned configured/onboarded one|nine Python-to-Rust native replay change-impact task.

tasks.description: Distinguish the native replay contract changes required to allow four parallel workers from unrelated worker-count settings.
tasks.prompt: Plan the likely impact of allowing four workers in native feed-hub replay parallel processing instead of the current maximum of three. Trace the Python adapter and session validation, the PyO3 boundary and Rust worker/queue pipeline, telemetry and evidence validation, benchmark measurement loops, and focused tests. Identify the source and test changes actually required, distinguish unrelated strategy-job worker_count=4 paths that already use a separate contract, and recommend the risk-appropriate validation commands. Cite implementation and test files with exact line ranges. Do not implement the change.
